title: CORE JSON Schema Extensions
description: Defines the x-* extension fields used by CORE JSON Schema documents and CORE editor metadata.

CoreRef.description: Foreign-key reference metadata: the annotated string field holds the CORE URN of another artifact. 'type' names the referenced artifact and may be either a concrete artifact URN (e.g. an Element URN — a strongly-typed FK whose existence is checked against the registry) or an 'urn:core:type:<Kind>' category URN (used by the generic CORE-IR artifact meta-schemas, where the concrete target is not fixed). The URN is always global.

type.description: CORE URN of the referenced artifact (a concrete artifact URN) or an 'urn:core:type:<Kind>' category URN.

XsdSource.description: URN of the raw XSD artifact from which a JSON Schema view was derived.

UiPosition.description: Visual position in the pipeline canvas (x/y coordinates in pixels).

UiStyles.description: Host UI state carried by a stored model — the editor diagram (nodes, edges, positions, labels). Opaque to the registry (host-owned, split off on read); shape is intentionally permissive.
